evidence.title: Building Blocks for the Web - shadcn/ui

name: shadcn/ui Blocks
summary: Official shadcn/ui building blocks: dashboard, sidebar, login and signup layouts to copy into React apps.
description: The blocks section of shadcn/ui: pre-made page layouts built from shadcn components, copy-pasted into your app and free to use. Featured groups are sidebar, login and signup; listed examples include a dashboard with sidebar, charts and data table, collapsible sidebar layouts and login pages with form and image.
contains: 63 registry items measured from the page
shown blocks: dashboard-01, sidebar-07, sidebar-03, login-03, login-04
free and open source, works with all React frameworks
